label: Attention, with and without a bias

spec.title: Attention in its three uses
spec.caption: d is the per-head width. Self-attention, cross-attention and pair-biased attention differ only in where Q, K, V and B come from.
spec.main_latex: \operatorname{Attn}(Q, K, V) = \operatorname{softmax}\!\Big(\frac{Q K^\top}{\sqrt d} + B\Big)\, V

steps.latex: Q = H W_Q,\quad K = H W_K,\quad V = H W_V,\quad B = 0
steps.explanation: Self-attention: queries, keys and values all come from the same tokens H (DiT, U-ViT, every U-Net attention layer).

steps.latex: Q = H_\text{img} W_Q,\quad K = H_\text{text} W_K,\quad V = H_\text{text} W_V
steps.explanation: Cross-attention (SD 1, SDXL): image positions ask, text tokens answer. Text is never updated.

steps.latex: Q = \big[H_\text{txt} W_Q^\text{txt};\, H_\text{img} W_Q^\text{img}\big],\ \text{likewise } K, V
steps.explanation: Joint attention (SD3, FLUX): each stream has its own weights, then one softmax runs over the concatenated sequence.
Pair bias (AlphaFold 3 and successors): every logit gets a learned bias from the pair representation, so geometry the trunk inferred steers what attends to what.
